snippet.title: God Feast - Friday Night Funkin' D-Side Remix (ft. Philiplol)
snippet.description:
yes this is official
don't mind the deadname in the bottom right

i had the opportunity to work on a song together with philiplol and i'm glad it was for such a banger mod.

thumbnail art by AnInternetsEcho (https://twitter.com/AnInternetsEcho)

FLP: https://www.mediafire.com/file/5isje6u1uiwg3hi/godfeastd_cheap_vers.zip/file
NOTE: we don't have permission to publicly release majin's vocals, so this is an altered version that uses the original majin (aka megadrive trumpet) vocals.

FNF D-Sides: https://gamebanana.com/mods/305122

Video made with FL Studio ZGameEditor Visualizer plugin
Effect author credits: Linear - StevenM,Dubswitcher,Youlean
TextDraw - Jph Wacheski http://jph_wacheski.itch.io/
